rules.allergens: US major nine (milk, egg, peanut, tree nuts, soy, wheat, fish, crustacean shellfish, sesame). Values: contains, may_contain, free_from, not_declared. Sources: the Kroger allergen list (GS1 containment levels), Open Food Facts allergen tags (contains) and trace tags (may contain), and a keyword check on the ingredient statement (source key ingredients). The most cautious value any source supports wins, in the order contains, may_contain, free_from, not_declared. conflict is true when one source says free_from and another says contains or may_contain. Kroger's 'Cereals and Their Derivatives' (gluten cereals) carries free_from and may_contain over to wheat; its Contains level counts as wheat only when an ingredient statement names wheat. Open Food Facts folds wheat into en:gluten, which counts as wheat on the same condition. 'Not intentionally nor inherently included' reads as not_declared. Coconut is not treated as a tree nut, molluscs are not a major allergen, and highly refined soybean and peanut oils are exempt, following FDA guidance.
rules.gluten_free: certified: the GFCO registry lists this UPC (matched from the cached GFCO Product Finder pages). claimed: Kroger manufacturerDeclarations or the product title says gluten free, or Open Food Facts carries en:no-gluten or en:gluten-free. conflict: a claim or certification plus an explicit gluten ingredient or a Contains statement naming a gluten grain, found by the gf-evidence detector in any ingredient statement (Kroger, FDC, Open Food Facts), or a Kroger allergen entry that contains wheat, barley or rye. not_claimed: no claim from any source. Oats and implied hits (bare flour, plain soy sauce) are listed in hits but do not trigger a conflict.
rules.nutrition: Per serving as labeled. Winner order: Kroger (retailer label data for the item on the shelf), then USDA FDC branded foods (per 100 g scaled by the FDC serving size in grams or millilitres), then Open Food Facts per-serving nutriments. conflict is true when another source differs from the winner by more than 20 percent and by more than a rounding floor (10 kcal, 1 g, 20 mg sodium). Kroger nutrient codes: ENER- calories, PRO- protein, FIBTSW fiber, SUGAD added sugars, SUGAR total sugars, FASAT saturated fat, NA sodium.
rules.joins: Sources join on GTIN-14. Kroger's 13-digit upc has no check digit, so the check digit is computed and appended. An Open Food Facts or FDC record is dropped as a barcode mismatch when its name and brand share no word with the Kroger description and brand (store-brand words excluded).
rules.ultra_processed: true when the Open Food Facts NOVA group is 4, false for groups 1 to 3, null when there is no Open Food Facts record or no NOVA group.

components.name: protein_density
components.rule: protein grams per 100 calories: 8 or more = +2, 5 or more = +1

components.name: protein_per_serving
components.rule: 15 g or more protein per serving = +1

components.name: fiber_per_serving
components.rule: 3 g or more fiber per serving = +1

components.name: added_sugars
components.rule: 5 g or less added sugar per serving = +1, more than 10 g = -1 (total sugars stand in when added sugars are missing)

components.name: saturated_fat
components.rule: more than 5 g saturated fat per serving = -1 (GI tolerance)

glp1.note: A transparent heuristic for demonstration, not medical advice. A production definition would be reviewed with legal and a dietitian.
